_meta.purpose: Settings of plain-text-review.json's in-scope groups (sentences, interface strings, clickable labels, form controls) that stay plain on purpose, each with its reason, and the form settings whose text may hold a link. Read by scripts/check-authored-text-rich.py.
_meta.exceptions: '<block>:<attr>' -> why it is not converted yet (a setting still plain). Every entry is a named gap, not a verdict: remove it when the setting converts. An exception naming no in-scope setting fails the check.
_meta.linksAllowed: '<block>:<attr>' of the 'form controls' group whose text prints outside a label, button or link, so a link format may stay. Every other form-control and clickable-label setting takes the no-link list.
_meta.noLink: '<block>:<attr>' of an interface string or sentence that prints inside a link, button or summary although its group does not say so: it takes the no-link list and prints with sgs_rich_text_kses( $v, false ).
